svg.aria-label: What I work on. AI Engineer at the Research Institute of Posts and Telecommunications since March 2025: multi-agent systems (LangGraph pipelines, 110+ chatbots in production), retrieval and search on Qdrant and FastAPI, and model distillation into local open-weights models. Undergraduate researcher with the University of Luxembourg since March 2026: multi-step agents that turn UI designs into working HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
